_meta.purpose: Domain knowledge the AI uses to disambiguate vague pest reports and ask the right narrowing questions. Loaded into the system prompt at proxy startup.

urgency_tiers.emergency: Same-day response expected (stinging swarm in occupied space, rodent in food prep, severe infestation impacting habitability).

id_questions: About the size of a thumbnail, light-brown with two dark stripes behind the head?
Are you seeing them mostly in the kitchen or bathroom?
Are they appearing day or night?
pests.visual_cues: 12-15mm, light-brown, two dark longitudinal stripes on the pronotum

id_questions: Larger than a German cockroach, about an inch, and very dark brown or black?
Mostly in basements, drains, or damp areas?
pests.visual_cues: 20-27mm, dark brown to black, glossy

id_questions: Are they large, a quarter inch or more, and black or reddish?
Have you seen any with wings, especially indoors?
Have you noticed any small piles of sawdust-like material near baseboards or window frames?
pests.visual_cues: 6-13mm, mostly black (sometimes reddish-black), single node on petiole

id_questions: Very small, under an eighth of an inch?
Mostly in trails on counters or sidewalks?
pests.visual_cues: 2.5-4mm, dark brown/black, faint stripes on head and thorax

id_questions: Tiny and yellowish/light brown rather than black?
Multiple separate trails branching across the home?
pests.visual_cues: 1.5-2mm, pale yellow to light brown, two-node petiole

id_questions: Are you finding small reddish-brown bugs the size of an apple seed in or near the bed?
Itchy bites in lines or clusters on parts of the body that touch bedding?
Any small dark spots on sheets, mattress seams, or behind the headboard?
pests.visual_cues: 4-5mm, oval, flat, reddish-brown (darker after a feed)

id_questions: Have you seen a nest, and if so where, eaves, ground, attic, in a wall?
How close to a doorway, kid's play area, or sleeping space is it?
Has anyone been stung, and is anyone in the home allergic?
urgency_override_rules: If nest is in the wall void or attic with active activity → emergency.
If solitary wasps without an identified nest → standard.
pests.visual_cues: yellow-and-black-banded body, narrow waist; nests are paper-grey or in-ground

id_questions: Fuzzy and golden-brown rather than smooth and yellow-banded?
Is this a swarm hanging on a branch, or have they moved into a structure?
pests.notes: Out-of-scope for chemical treatment in BC, refer to a local beekeeper for live removal. AI should capture details and flag for human follow-up.
pests.visual_cues: fuzzy, golden-brown with darker bands

id_questions: Small, about the size of a thumb, with a long thin tail and big ears?
Are you seeing droppings the size of rice grains?
Hearing scratching in walls or ceilings, especially at night?
pests.visual_cues: 7-10cm body, gray-brown, large ears, pointed snout

id_questions: Larger than a mouse, body alone the size of a hand?
Heavy thick body, smaller ears than a mouse?
Droppings the size of olive pits?
Mostly at ground level / basement / outdoors near garbage?
pests.visual_cues: 20-25cm body, brown/grey, blunt snout, tail shorter than body

id_questions: Slimmer and more agile than a Norway rat, with a long tail and large ears?
Hearing them in the attic, ceiling, or upper floors rather than basement?
pests.visual_cues: 16-22cm body, dark brown/black, pointed snout, tail longer than body

id_questions: Did you see a red hourglass mark on the underside?
Where did you find it, woodpile, garage corner, outdoor shed?
Did anyone get bitten?
urgency_override_rules: If anyone was bitten → advise calling 8-1-1 or seeking medical attention; flag for human follow-up.
pests.visual_cues: black widow: shiny black with red hourglass; hobo: brown with chevron pattern

id_questions: Small, silver, teardrop-shaped, fast-moving when you turn the light on?
Mostly in bathrooms or laundry rooms?
pests.visual_cues: 12-19mm, metallic silver, teardrop shape, three tail filaments

id_questions: Large, mostly black with a shiny abdomen, hovering around wood structures?
Have you seen perfectly round holes (about half-inch) in eaves, deck, or fence wood?
pests.visual_cues: large (similar to bumblebee), shiny black abdomen rather than fuzzy

id_questions: Lots of slow-moving large flies clustered on warm windows, especially in fall or warm winter days?
Mostly upstairs / attic-side?
pests.visual_cues: 8-10mm, dark grey with golden hairs on thorax

id_questions: Tiny and reddish-eyed, hovering around fruit, recycling, or drains?
pests.visual_cues: 3mm, tan with red eyes

id_questions: Tiny fuzzy moth-like flies near sinks, tubs, or floor drains?
pests.visual_cues: 2mm, fuzzy moth-like, dark grey

id_questions: Scratching or running sounds in the attic, especially morning and dusk?
Any chewed entry points around the roofline or vents?
pests.visual_cues: n/a, usually identified by sound + entry holes

id_questions: Heavy thumping at night rather than light scratching?
Have you seen damage to attic insulation, vents, or roof shingles?
pests.notes: Wildlife removal often requires a separate licensed wildlife operator in BC. AI captures details and flags for human follow-up.
pests.visual_cues: large mammal, masked face, ringed tail

pests.common_name: Out-of-scope (dead animal, skunk, bear, deer, bird in chimney, etc.)
pests.notes: {{business_short_name}} does not handle dead-animal pickup, large mammals, or birds. AI should politely explain, take a message in case the team can refer the caller to the right service (city / wildlife rescue), and end the call.
pests.visual_cues: n/a
